title: agent-qa
body: Natural-language application testing with persistent memory and validated self-improvement.
plain_description: Test web, Android and iOS apps using natural-language tasks. agent-qa reuses validated testing experience through persistent memory and self-improvement, with CLI, dashboard and MCP access.
technical_description: A TypeScript application-testing agent requiring Node.js 24 or newer and a configured model. It supports local OpenAI-compatible model servers, including LM Studio and Ollama, as well as optional cloud providers. Local-model hardware needs depend on the selected model and server. Application targets may need network access; end-to-end offline operation and telemetry behavior have not been independently verified for this listing.
